subject.title: feat: bind signed ClawHub default feed trust

question: Should this foundation merge before the ClawHub signer, corrected feed specification, and production public key are ready, or should the permanent default trust root be reviewed and proven in the same landing sequence?
rationale: The branch defines which keys and payload identities can authorize marketplace content, while its final publisher and production trust root do not yet exist; automation cannot choose that deployment boundary.

options.title: Complete the trust chain first
options.body: Keep the draft open until the signer, specification, production public key, generated config baseline, and live end-to-end proof are ready together.

options.title: Land only generic identity binding
options.body: Narrow this PR to custom-profile `feedId` enforcement and defer all default ClawHub trust-root and environment-override behavior.

options.title: Accept an interim foundation
options.body: Merge the env-driven foundation while explicitly confirming that production default signing remains inactive until a separately reviewed key lands.

recommendation.title: Complete the trust chain first
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until the signer, specification, production public key, generated config baseline, and live end-to-end proof are ready together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent signed-feed verifier and threshold-hardening history makes this contributor the strongest available technical routing candidate for the security-boundary choice.
